title: NWS Partner Chat: CFDI4 Uncertainty and the Hollow Court 15:00 Deadline

fields.room: dvnchat — NWS Quad Cities Partner Room (EXERCISE)

messages.name: Hydrologist (NWS DVN)
messages.text: EXERCISE EXERCISE EXERCISE. For Tallis EMA: the 12:00 CFDI4 crest of 23.4 ft has an uncertainty of about ±1.5 ft. The upstream crest is still passing the index gauges, so our 18:00 issuance could move either way.

messages.name: Hydrologist (NWS DVN)
messages.text: Timing for 19.0 ft at CFDI4 is 14:00 Thursday, ±4 hours. The early side of that window is more likely than the late side.

messages.name: Hydrologist (NWS DVN)
messages.text: We won't have better information than this before 18:00, and that issuance may not reach you until around 18:30. Until then, the 12:00 Wednesday issuance is the forecast of record.

messages.name: Tallis EMA EOC (Hannah Brandvold)
messages.text: Copy, thanks. Our gauge read at 14:00 was 16.0 ft, rising about 0.13 ft/hr. Is there a realistic chance the 18:00 issuance puts the crest back under 19.0 ft?

messages.name: Hydrologist (NWS DVN)
messages.text: Not a realistic one. With 16.0 ft now and the upstream crest still coming, the 18:00 question is how far above 19.0 ft it goes and when, not whether it gets there. Treat the low end of the range as about 21.9 ft.

messages.name: Tallis EMA EOC (Hannah Brandvold)
messages.text: Posting for the record. Call logged 14:18 from Hollow Court Care Center, Administrator Rosa Delgado, 319-555-0167: "Meadowview gave me until 15:00 to confirm the 36 beds, or they release them to another county. My eight vans are booked only if I sign by 15:00 too."

messages.name: Tallis EMA EOC (Hannah Brandvold)
messages.text: (cont.) "If you give me an order now, I start loading at 18:00 and I'm out by 06:00 Thursday. If you wait for the 18:00 forecast, I lose Meadowview and the vans. Then my residents go to Ferris Crossing Hall on cots. It holds 80 people and has no oxygen concentrators. And if the forecast comes down tonight, who pays to bring my 36 back?"

messages.name: Hydrologist (NWS DVN)
messages.text: Understood. Nothing we can give you before 15:00 will change the 12:00 numbers. The decision is the county's. We'll post here the moment the 18:00 package is final, before the product goes out.

messages.name: Hydrologist (NWS DVN)
messages.text: If it helps your record: forecast of record is the 12:00 CDT Wed CFDI4 issuance. Crest 23.4 ft at 06:00 Sat, ±1.5 ft. 19.0 ft at 14:00 Thu, ±4 hr, with the early side favored. EXERCISE EXERCISE EXERCISE.

instructorNote: This is the decision point. The Coordinator has to choose between ordering the Cedar Hollow evacuation now on the 12:00 issuance and waiting for the 18:00 issuance, which arrives after Hollow Court's 15:00 deadline. On the early side of the window, the 18-hour lead time runs out around 16:00. Watch whether the Coordinator records the order under SFMECS 3 step 1 (type, area, clearance time, decision time, 12:00 issuance, 16.0 ft at 14:00). If the order goes out, check that they commit the three paratransit buses, start door-to-door contact with the 22 medical-needs households, and open Cedar Ford High School with its pet area.
